source: Self-annotated Amharic Educational Quality dataset (monolingual Amharic). Annotation led by Hailay Kidu Teklehaymanot.

cleaning.note: Dropped rows were a leaked spreadsheet formula (=AI(...)) and a #ERROR! cell, neither of which is annotated content. Duplicates are verbatim repeats of the same (text,label) pair in the source export.

label_scale: paper Sec 7, ordinal 1-5 plus a non-ordinal flag value 6

non_ordinal_flag.note: Not a 6th point above 'Excellent' -- a separate flag for unreadable/garbled/off-topic content. run_tc.py treats all six as unordered classes.

split_method: identical to data/scripts/prepare_tc.py stratified_split() used for Tigrinya
class_balance_note: Label 2 is 65% of the corpus; a majority-class baseline scores ~66% accuracy. Label 5 has only 2 instances, both retained in train by the split guard (a class with <1 remaining example after dev/test allocation is not split), so dev and test contain no label-5 examples.
